comparison.objective: Replace a worn soft-gripper finger and refit its plate and screws.
comparison.physical_skill: Remove and bin a flexible finger, seat a replacement, position a fork plate, and place three M3 screws into small holes.
comparison.success_condition: New finger and plates correctly seated, all three screws placed, worn part binned, good finger undisturbed, and components released and still.
comparison.reason: This is multi-part disassembly/reassembly with repeated small-part placement. It does not require parameter tuning from measured machine response or guarded impact cycling.
